北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光正好，气温舒适，紫外线较强，记得防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Beijing, pleasant temps. UV is strong, remember sun protection and hydration!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波阴天，体感适中。湿度有点高，出门可以备把伞。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy and pleasant. Humidity is a bit high, consider taking an umbrella.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天湿度高，体感略闷，出门注意防潮，带把伞有备无患。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and humid. It feels a bit muggy, bring an umbrella.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州高温炎热，体感近 39℃。防暑降温是关键，避免中暑哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is scorching hot, feels like 39℃. Stay cool and hydrated to prevent heatstroke!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳烈日炎炎，体感温度高。注意防晒和补水，谨防中暑。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and hot, feels like 37℃. Protect yourself from sun and heat.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天潮湿，体感微凉。出门注意防潮，备件薄外套。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and damp, feels a bit cool. Bring a light jacket and watch out for humidity.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，风力较大，体感微凉。多穿一件，小心着凉哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy with strong winds, feels cool. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感舒适，湿度适中，正是户外活动的好天气！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is partly cloudy and pleasant, moderate humidity. Great weather for outdoor activities!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷潮湿，风力较大。记得添衣保暖，尤其注意防湿。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cold, damp, and windy. Dress warmly and pay attention to the high humidity.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天微凉，体感舒适。出门记得带件外套，以防天气变化。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and slightly cool, feels comfortable. Bring a jacket in case the weather changes.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天潮湿，体感微凉。湿度高，注意防潮和保暖哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and damp, feels a bit cool. High humidity, remember to keep warm and dry.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨气温较低，体感寒冷。风力大，务必多穿衣物保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cold, feels like 8℃, and windy. Bundle up warmly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳风力强劲，体感较冷。注意防风保暖，避免着凉。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is very windy and feels cold. Dress warmly to protect from the wind and cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感舒适。湿度适中，是个适合出行的好天气。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and pleasant, moderate humidity. Good weather for a stroll.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天闷热，风力强劲。湿度大，出门注意防潮防风哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, muggy, and very windy. High humidity, watch out for dampness and wind.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感微凉有风。记得添衣，享受海边好风光。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is partly cloudy, cool, and windy. Dress warmly and enjoy the seaside view.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴空万里，风力强劲。体感较冷，记得多穿衣物保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny and very windy, feels cold. Dress warmly to stay cozy!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦有小雨，湿度非常高。出门记得带伞，注意防潮防滑。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu has light rain, very high humidity. Bring an umbrella, watch out for dampness and slippery surfaces.
漳浦.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微热，湿度适中，出门体感舒适，祝您有个好心情！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and warm, moderate humidity. Enjoy your day!
